decision: Wrote docs/product-vision.md and linked it from the README before any code change
why: Dan set five rules and said the vision lands first

decision: Treated Hilt as already done and left AppContainer as test names only
why: SkimApplication is HiltAndroidApp and no AppContainer class exists

decision: Did not pick an ad-blocking mechanism
why: Filter lists and on-device versus a service is Dan's choice. The release proxy contract stays the AI proxy.

decision: Pointed browser and data at domain.url and deleted the data pass-throughs
why: The helpers already lived in domain. DomainBoundaryTest now rejects the data names.

decision: Search and theme dialogs save through SettingsViewModel
why: The routes were launching repository writes themselves

decision: Removed five UI files from the browser allowlist
why: Those files only needed window privacy, open pages, download notices, or an external-app launch

decision: Started releaseSmoke assemble and an API 36 emulator after opening /dev/kvm
why: The first emulator exit was missing KVM permission. chmod 666 made accel work.

decision: Drove releaseSmoke through welcome, setup, and home on emulator-5580
why: Nested KVM left the guest idle, so the boot used -accel off. Opening a page then SIGTRAPped in Trichrome while creating a WebView.

decision: Page load stays a Trichrome SIGTRAP under TCG on API 34 and API 35
why: App creates the WebView on the main thread from the Activity. API 34 WebView 113 dies in the V8 snapshot checksum (ud2 at libmonochrome 0x291b1fd). API 35 WebView 124 dies at the same CrRendererMain SIGTRAP SI_KERNEL, pc 0x28a7dba. KVM boots the host check and then the guest never comes up.

decision: Search expands with defaultSpatialSpec, screens slide with slowSpatialSpec, tab gaps are 8 and 16
why: Dan asked for those three gaps. Sheets stay overlays so they do not slide. Theme and FLAG_SECURE still follow the back stack in the same composition.

decision: Recorded cold startup on the API 35 emulator and did not ship a profile from it
why: androidx.benchmark warns the run is an emulator. Median time to first frame was 23.3 s over 5 iterations, and the sampled frame count was 1. That number is the software emulator, not Compose. A profile generated there would train the wrong paths.
